title: Take With the Big Piece
setup: Black's rook on e8 is defended by the bishop, and its rook on b4 is chewing at your queenside.
hint: Both of your heavy pieces bear on the same square. Work out which one has to go in first.
explanation:
## The Idea

The instinct is to protect the queenside. Ignore it. {{Qxe8+}} forces {{Bxe8}}, dragging the bishop onto the square your rook already commands, and {{Rxe8#}} ends the game before Black's counterplay has a move to make.
